## Highlights

- Adds `carve.symbols` configuration for inline maps, JSON files, or merged
  lists of both.
- Tests against released `carve-lang` 0.1.2 while retaining the verified
  `>= 0.1.1, < 0.2.0` consumer range.
- Keeps publishing on RubyGems trusted publishing and installs the built gem in
  isolation before release.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/markup-carve/jekyll-carve/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1
